description:
Update an email in Propstack.

Use this tool to:
- Mark an email as read or unread
- Archive an email
- Categorize an email (set message_category_id)
- Link an email to contacts, properties, or projects

Only provide the fields you want to change.

client_ids.description: Contact IDs to link this email to

project_ids.description: Project IDs to link this email to

property_ids.description: Property IDs to link this email to

name: update_email
